scope: Complete author reading of all ten current API-section pages across the core API, identity and list/limit review passes. Source and scoped execution evidence support the stated limits; not independent usability measurement, every API path or final candidate validation.

reviews.reason: Introduces model/ViewSet/serializer/identity roles, exact routes, customization choices, custom-action limits and error-response navigation.
Separates registration from declaration, lists implemented defaults and unsupported switches, and qualifies query/object and error boundaries.
Gives direct and discovery alternatives with exact helper arguments, avoids duplicate registration and explains nested ownership responsibilities.
Explains operation-specific wiring, synchronous hooks, extra/read-only input, partial/null limits and relation representation.
Discloses missing automatic HTTP permission wrapping before the example and demonstrates explicit delegation to checked retrieve.
Separates verified credentials, canonical Principal and user-shaped state; supplies account helpers without implying complete login/provider integration.
Separates view, list, create and object checks; requires synchronous hooks and qualifies composition and custom actions.
Executes a shared allowlist example, explains coercion/search/ordering limits and preserves separate tenant/policy requirements.
Starts with default supported HTTP pagination, discloses metadata loss before custom class details, and qualifies cursor consistency/cost.
Restricts the claim to Admin POSTs with local counters and explicit proxy trust; makes REST/MCP limits application-owned.
